summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. I build and debug robotics systems end to end: a voice-controlled Jetson and Arduino robotic arm with TensorRT YOLO perception, kinematics and SE(3) coordinate-transform tooling, and closed-loop control on encoder odometry. Strong Python and C++ on Linux, with 11 integration failures diagnosed and resolved across software, electronics and sensors through systematic hardware debugging.

Robotics & Control: Kinematics and coordinate transforms (DH parameters, SE(3))
Deployment: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system (hardware and software integration): Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller on a WebSocket fabric.

Integrated perception and machine-learning models into the running robot: TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing, faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (gripper close at 25 mm) via a TCA9548A I2C mux.

Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through hardware debugging; evaluated 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Deployed the Jetson arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device registration.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/OpenGL desktop tool with a custom SE(3) math engine for composing parent-child coordinate-frame transforms and inspecting live 4x4 matrices per frame.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot on Arduino Due: derived actual heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR, 2.9 cm wheels) and fed angular error back into rotation PWM, holding course during translation.
